purpose: Teach: 慎太郎/康夫/優美/和也/正彦/すず/恭子/足下

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、石原慎太郎元都知事の小説を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your regulars was talking about former Tokyo Governor Ishihara Shintaro's novel.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle pace—like sharing something she noticed and thought Aoi would appreciate. No rush, just fondness for the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の康夫さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer was having tea with their friend Yasuo the other day.
lines.style: Soft, conversational. Speaking from memory—not performing the observation, just offering it naturally. Slight lift at the end, inviting recognition.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の優美さんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you have a regular who comes in often with their friend Yumi.
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady rhythm. Like cataloging the small patterns she's noticed in the café. Tone of gentle noticing, no judgment—just presence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の和也くんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your customers brought in their grandchild, Kazuya, last week.
lines.style: Quiet smile in the voice. Tender pace—the kind of detail Aoi would love to hear. Slight warmth on the child's name, like she noticed the joy in it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の正彦さんと打ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer was meeting with their friend Masahiko to discuss something.
lines.style: Even, observant tone. Respectful distance—noticing without intruding. Small pause before the friend's name, as if placing the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの名前をすずちゃんって付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your regulars named their pet Suzu—isn't that sweet?
lines.style: Warmth breaking through. Slight lift and brightness on the pet's name. The affection genuine, not performed. A moment of shared delight in the small thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お姉様のお名前が恭子さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you know one of your customers has an older sister named Kyoko?
lines.style: Conversational, curious. Like drawing Aoi into something she'd gathered. Natural pace, genuine interest in what Aoi might know or remember about this connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「足下を見られない様気を付けたい」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer mentioned wanting to be careful not to let people take advantage of them.
lines.style: Closer, more serious. Thoughtful pause before the heart of the sentence. Respect in the voice—honoring something vulnerable they'd shared. Quiet, steady delivery.
